subject: MAP: capacity handover & GPU tranche check-in
messages:
From: Alice Wong <alice.wong@verticahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Sam Lee <sam.lee@verticahealth.com>, vertica-procurement@verticahealth.com
Date: 2027-03-29T09:12:00Z
Subject: Kickoff: MAP + capacity handover (GPU pools)

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the demo last week — Vertica is keen to move toward a committed capacity arrangement for inference. Before we lock numbers with procurement we want a short mutual action plan that shows:
- evaluation milestones (bench timeframe, P50/P95 targets)
- target GPU pool sizing for our 3-phase rollout (staging, canary, prod)
- lead times and procurement handoffs (esp. for private/VPC options)

Can you share a draft MAP and a recommended tranche schedule? Our procurement team prefers a 60-day lead time for private deployments and will need SOC2 evidence.

Thanks,
Alice

--
Alice Wong
Head of AI Platforms, Vertica Health
alice.wong@verticahealth.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Wong <alice.wong@verticahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-03-29T11:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + capacity handover (GPU pools)

Hi Alice — great to hear. I've sketched a short MAP and a tranche schedule that aligns to your 60-day procurement constraint. Draft attached (MAP-Vertica-v0.3.xlsx). High level:

1) Evaluation window (2 weeks):
   - Week 1: integration + baseline perf (closed test set)
   - Week 2: load emulation (1k rps spike, 99th pct latency check)

2) Tranche sizing (initial recommendation):
   - Staging: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs (for smoke + load tests)
   - Canary: 8 x A100-equivalent GPUs (50% expected traffic)
   - Prod tranche 1: 24 x A100-equivalent GPUs (target steady-state for launch)
   - Buffer/burst pool: +8 GPUs reserved for spikes and failover

3) Lead times & handoffs:
   - Private deployment lead time: ~60 days from signed SOW to VPC handover
   - Dedicated pool: 30 days to allocate once commit is accepted
   - Action: procurement sends standard PO template; we return draft SOW within 3 business days.

I've also included a short acceptance checklist and SOC2 summary (SOC2-summary-2026.pdf). Ben / Vivek — please sanity-check the tranche numbers and any constraints we should call out for on-prem sizing.

Next step: can Vertica confirm target launch window (tentative May 24) and whether you want staged canary traffic split?

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-03-29T13:07:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + capacity handover (GPU pools)

Agree with the structure. A couple of notes on sizing and conservatism:
- If Vertica expects multimodal workloads (long-form generation + embeddings), recommend sizing prod tranche at 30 GPUs or provide a mixed-ram profile (16x 80GB + 14x 40GB equivalents) to keep latency SLOs.
- Buffer of +8 is fine but call it a burst pool billed at on-demand; makes economics easier for procurement.
- For private/VPC installs we need lead-time gates: networking signoff (20 days) and key material exchange (KMS/HSM) — recommend adding those as milestones in the MAP.

I'll update the attached CSV with two alternate sizing scenarios (GPU-tranche-sizing.csv).

-Ben

From: Sam Lee <sam.lee@verticahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Alice Wong <alice.wong@verticahealth.com>
Cc: vertica-procurement@verticahealth.com
Date: 2027-03-29T15:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + capacity handover (GPU pools)

Thanks Marissa / Ben — this is helpful. A few clarifying points from procurement:
- We can sign a SOW + PO for a dedicated pool (30-day allocation) but private/VPC requires an internal change control and we typically allow 60–75 days.
- SOC2 docs are required for approval — attaching our checklist to procurement thread after this.
- Pricing: our CFO will want a 12-month committed price; can you include a staggered discount for tranches (e.g., 5% first tranche, 10% >12 GPUs, 15% >24 GPUs)?

Proposed near-term milestones:
- 2027-04-05: Complete evaluation perf run and gate decision
- 2027-04-12: Procurement sign-off on SOW
- 2027-05-24: Target launch (prod traffic ramp begins)

If those dates are realistic, procurement will file the change ticket for private and start the PO cycle.

Best,
Sam

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Sam Lee <sam.lee@verticahealth.com>, Alice Wong <alice.wong@verticahealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, priyom_das@redwood.com, vertica-procurement@verticahealth.com
Date: 2027-03-30T10:22:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP + capacity handover (GPU pools)

Sam — thanks. Dates look achievable with the caveat we lock the SOW by 2027-04-08 to meet the private 60-day handoff. I've incorporated Ben's alternate sizing scenarios and added two procurement-friendly pricing tiers into the MAP (see attached MAP-Vertica-v0.3.xlsx).

Action items pulled into MAP (highlights):
- Evaluation: Redwood to run perf suite (we will share raw logs for gating) — complete by 2027-04-05.
- Procurement: Vertica to issue PO template by 2027-04-07; Redwood to return SOW by 2027-04-08.
- SOC2: Redwood provided SOC2-summary-2026.pdf; Vertica procurement to confirm docs acceptable by 2027-04-06.
- Network/KMS: Vertica to confirm network CIDRs and KMS endpoint by 2027-04-12 (we'll schedule a tech handoff).
- DocuSign: MAP & SOW ready for signature — link: https://www.docusign.com/rdw/vertica-map-sign

Please confirm agreement on the milestones above. If you confirm today, we'll set a canary traffic split doc and schedule the first integration run for 2027-04-01.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments referenced: MAP-Vertica-v0.3.xlsx, GPU-tranche-sizing.csv, SOC2-summary-2026.pdf
